findings.fix_guide: 1) Select-String 'buff-lang/' across README + installers. 2) Verify HTTP 200 per URL. 3) Replace with canonical origin or document mirror in docs/RELEASE.md.

confidence.rationale: Inconsistency verified in-repo; sibling squad verified live 404 for buff-lang/buff.

fp_risk_self_assessment.reasoning: Live 404 verified by sibling squad; clone URL contradicting origin is wrong under any layout.
